_comment: Small offline sample of well-known advisories so the tool works without network. NOT exhaustive - use --osv for a live lookup against osv.dev.

pyyaml.summary: Arbitrary code execution via full_load / FullLoader

requests.summary: Authorization header leaked on HTTPS->HTTP redirect

urllib3.summary: Improper certificate validation when custom CA certs are used

flask.summary: Session cookie may be cached and shared by proxies

axios.summary: SSRF via redirect to a different host

node-fetch.summary: Cookie/Authorization headers forwarded to third-party hosts on redirect
